nodes.norm_label: next.js agent rules (breaking changes, read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: Next.js version differs from training data; agents must read bundled docs before coding. Block is regenerated by next dev (generate-agent-files.js), so committing it keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Color Tokens (ink, ink-2, ink-3, cream, gold, gold-deep, paper, ember)
nodes.norm_label: color tokens (ink, ink-2, ink-3, cream, gold, gold-deep, paper, ember)
nodes.rationale: No decorative gradients; gold never for long body text; alternate ink/ink-2 to avoid light/dark jumps on home.

nodes.label: Components (Button, Navbar, Mobile bar, Photos, Callout, Sheet)
nodes.norm_label: components (button, navbar, mobile bar, photos, callout, sheet)

nodes.label: Pre-delivery Checklist (viewports, touch targets, contrast, Lighthouse >= 90, no invented content)
nodes.norm_label: pre-delivery checklist (viewports, touch targets, contrast, lighthouse >= 90, no invented content)

nodes.label: Brand Direction (black, logo gold, Trajan capitals, flame rules)
nodes.norm_label: brand direction (black, logo gold, trajan capitals, flame rules)
nodes.rationale: Taken from restaurant's own sign, menu and posts. Rejected Liquid Glass (poor performance/contrast, generic), Playfair+Karla (Cinzel matches Trajan-like logo), light background (brand is black; paper only on booking page for legibility).

nodes.norm_label: design system master - prometeo fine dining

nodes.label: Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, Motion, Supabase, Vercel
nodes.norm_label: stack: next.js 16, react 19, tailwind v4, motion, supabase, vercel

nodes.label: npm Scripts Call node next Directly (& in path)
nodes.norm_label: npm scripts call node next directly (& in path)
nodes.rationale: The folder path contains '&' (A & C HOLDING) which breaks Windows .cmd shims.

nodes.label: Data Model Propagation Chain (types -> schemas -> seed -> admin forms)
nodes.norm_label: data model propagation chain (types -> schemas -> seed -> admin forms)
nodes.rationale: Settings live in jsonb so no migration needed; new columns on categories/dishes/bookings must go in supabase/schema.sql.

nodes.label: Graphify Update Workflow
nodes.rationale: Code changes use AST-only graphify update (no cost); doc changes need /graphify . --update; post-commit hook rebuilds code graph only.

nodes.label: Admin Area (Prenotazioni, Menu, Locale e orari)
nodes.norm_label: admin area (prenotazioni, menu, locale e orari)

nodes.label: To Complete With Client (hours, prices, allergens, privacy, photo rights)
nodes.norm_label: to complete with client (hours, prices, allergens, privacy, photo rights)
nodes.rationale: Allergens intentionally left empty so the kitchen must specify them; opening hours indicative because not published anywhere.

nodes.label: create_booking SQL Function (atomic slot lock)
nodes.rationale: Locks the time slot during insert so two customers cannot take the last seats simultaneously.

nodes.label: Design Direction (black, gold, Cinzel, Hanken Grotesk)
nodes.norm_label: design direction (black, gold, cinzel, hanken grotesk)
nodes.rationale: Derived from the restaurant's own material: logo gold, Roman capitals like the sign; home fully dark with ink/ink-2 alternation, light paper only on Prenota.

nodes.label: Local Demo Mode (data/local-db.json)
nodes.rationale: Runs without Supabase env vars; does not work on Vercel because files are not writable there.

nodes.label: QR Table Menu (/qr)
nodes.rationale: For seated guests: no booking buttons, not indexed; QR generated only after NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL points at the final domain.

nodes.label: Supabase Setup (EU Frankfurt, schema.sql, seed, admins)
nodes.norm_label: supabase setup (eu frankfurt, schema.sql, seed, admins)
nodes.rationale: EU Frankfurt region chosen for GDPR; sign-ups disabled so admins are only created manually.

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.rationale: Supabase first, then Vercel; pushes to main auto-deploy; public pages are static and regenerate on admin save.

nodes.label: Rule: Every Change Propagates
nodes.rationale: A task is not finished until graph, README, design system, data model and env vars are aligned in the same change.

nodes.label: Rule: Never Invent Content
nodes.rationale: Every text, price, allergen or review needs a documented source in README; self-written texts marked da approvare.

nodes.label: Graphify Query-First Rules
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return scoped subgraphs much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or grep output.
